mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_group(id, name, description, avatar, owner_user_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{group.id}, #{group.name}, #{group.description}, #{group.avatar}, #{group.ownerUserId}, #{group.createdAt}, #{group.updatedAt})
mapper.sql: g.id, g.name, g.description, g.avatar, CASE WHEN g.owner_user_id = #{userId} THEN 'OWNER' ELSE 'MEMBER' END AS role, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_member WHERE group_id = g.id) AS member_count, g.created_at, g.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT users.id AS user_id, users.nickname, users.avatar, CASE WHEN users.id = g.owner_user_id THEN 'OWNER' ELSE 'MEMBER' END AS role, membership.joined_at FROM group_member membership JOIN app_user users ON users.id = membership.user_id JOIN chat_group g ON g.id = membership.group_id WHERE g.id = #{groupId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN users.id = g.owner_user_id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, membership.joined_at, users.id
SELECT user_id::text FROM group_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY joined_at, user_id
SELECT owner_user_id::text FROM chat_group WHERE id = #{groupId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM group_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND user_id = #{userId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM group_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT users.id AS user_id, users.nickname, users.avatar, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM group_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND user_id = users.id) AS joined FROM app_user users WHERE position(lower(#{search}) in lower(users.nickname)) > 0 ORDER BY users.created_at, users.id LIMIT 21 OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_group SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, avatar = #{avatar}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{groupId}
UPDATE chat_group SET owner_user_id = #{userId}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{groupId}
UPDATE chat_group SET updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{groupId}
